detail: HTTP 403 to every automated fetcher (curl, WebFetch) - American Legal bot-protects the code library. Metadata cataloged (Titles 10/11, numbering, current-through). Not scraped around per repo rules. Recovery paths: manual browser access, or the county Community Development Dept.

County publishes a browsable RESOLUTIONS archive (684 R-YYYY-NNNN docs 2019-2026) but NO ordinance archive. Ordinances surface only as (a) the codified American Legal code and (b) scattered wp-content/uploads/comdev-ordinance-*.pdf (individually linked from topic pages). Only 2025-1295-O recovered this pass. Adopted-ordinance NUMBERS are discoverable in the OCR legislative minutes corpus (fts search).
